'''Koep''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army]] who was stationed in the [[High Security Section]] of [[Belsavis prison]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] penal colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], during the [[invasion of Belsavis]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Koep appears as a Classic Gear Vendor for Republic players on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
